highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 with expanded GTK4 and Tizen support.
highlights_body: It restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and aligns native assets with current .NET and platform toolchains.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core-fork cleanup.
NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover installed system fonts.
GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with pixel scaling support.
Updates Tizen packaging and native builds for the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain.
Updates .NET preview pins and WebAssembly native assets to keep upcoming .NET consumers aligned.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp build alignment for .NET 11 preview assets, current Windows toolchains, and Tizen 10 packaging.
